generated_pair_policy: 120 newly frozen test base scenes, each has chronological forward and exactly reversed video; balanced five direction classes, stable target-color query, independently moving distractor.
label_blindness: tracker reads only raw video pixels and question string; no scene metadata, reference labels, options or answer string used
novelty_limit: Procedural 2D color objects and fixed camera; classical CV already able to solve. This is diagnostic VLM evidence-fusion, not a general video tracking algorithm.
wrong_hint_interpretation: Deliberate contradictory reverse-order numeric measurement against original RGB chronology, not a real sensor signal.
